The '''Socialist Republic of Aurendale''', commonly called '''Aurendale''', is an island democratic socialist republic in the [[Serenith Ocean]].

The source describes Aurendale as a technologically advanced island nation known for renewable energy, high-tech exports, pharmaceuticals, and Aurendalian whiskey. Its capital is [[Eolus City]].

== Geography ==

Aurendale is source-attested as an island nation located roughly between the Kingdom of Khopda and Chikhanbaatar Khanate. The exact position, maritime zones, and relationship to [[Erythrea]] need map review before publication.

== Government ==

The Aurendale source describes a democratic socialist republic led by a prime minister. Its parliament has a directly elected National Assembly and a Senate chosen by the National Assembly from nominees.

The source names three political parties: the Democratic Socialist Party, the Progressive People's Party, and the New Tech Alliance. It says the New Tech Alliance is the current leading party, but the article does not provide a year for that claim. This draft does not treat that party control as fixed in 1994.

== Economy And Society ==

Aurendale's source economy is built around high-tech products, pharmaceuticals, renewable energy, and whiskey exports. The source also says Eolus City is powered by wind, solar, and nuclear energy.

Aurendalian is the official language. Aurendalian Gaelic is source-attested as the second most spoken language.

== AGGPI Note ==

The AGGPI source lists Aurendale as a founding member in 1995, while the existing 1994-back AGGPI draft emphasizes Solara and the [[Union of Zhensanov]] as the November 1994 founding sponsors. This draft preserves Aurendale's AGGPI relevance as an open chronology/source issue rather than silently rewriting the AGGPI founding sequence.

== Earlier Timeline Note ==

Murah-related source material mentions Aurendale-linked representatives, communities, or interests during the 1891 [[Siege of Murah]] crisis. This may prove that Aurendale existed as a diplomatic or economic actor by that period, but this draft does not use it as a confirmed formation date.
